general.title: Statistik
general.description: Kontrol bagaimana data keuangan Anda dihitung dan ditampilkan di seluruh aplikasi.

creditLimit.label: Sertakan batas kredit dalam saldo
creditLimit.description: Saat diaktifkan, batas kredit dikurangkan dari saldo akun dalam statistik dan grafik tren saldo. Ini menunjukkan posisi keuangan aktual Anda, bukan kredit yang tersedia.

manualTransferMatching.label: Cocokkan transfer dengan akun manual
manualTransferMatching.description: Izinkan transfer yang terdeteksi otomatis untuk menghubungkan transaksi bank yang tersinkronisasi dengan transaksi yang Anda buat secara manual.

pendingBankTransactions.label: Import pending bank transactions
pendingBankTransactions.description: Import transactions your bank reports before it has booked them. They're marked as pending, don't change the account balance, and can lack the merchant name and final details. Once the bank books or cancels them, they're updated or removed.
pendingBankTransactions.descriptionSelfHost: Store Enable Banking transactions before the bank books them. They're marked as pending, never change the account balance, and often lack merchant details until booked. Other providers aren't affected: SimpleFIN and LunchFlow always import booked transactions only, and Monobank imports every transaction as a regular one.
pendingBankTransactions.errorNotification: Failed to update pending transactions setting

bankSyncSchedule.label: Bank sync schedule
bankSyncSchedule.description: Connected bank accounts sync automatically at these times, shown in your local time. Pick the same time twice to sync once a day.
bankSyncSchedule.errorNotification: Failed to update bank sync schedule

quickStart.label: Quick start guide
quickStart.description: Show the onboarding checklist on the dashboard. Turn it off to hide the guide; turn it back on to bring it back at any time.

savingsCategories.label: Hitung kategori sebagai tabungan
savingsCategories.description: Pengeluaran pada kategori ini (dan subkategorinya) dikecualikan dari pengeluaran dalam analitik arus kas, sehingga dihitung sebagai tabungan bulanan dan tingkat tabungan.

taxCategories.label: Tax categories
taxCategories.description: Spending in these categories is shown as taxes in the money flow chart instead of as an expense. Subcategories are included.

filterCategoriesByType.label: Match categories to transaction type
filterCategoriesByType.description: The transaction form lists only income categories for income and all other categories for expenses. Search still finds every category.
filterCategoriesByType.errorNotification: Failed to update the category list setting

incomeCategories.label: Income categories
incomeCategories.description: Categories that count as income. Subcategories are included.

defaultAccount.label: Akun default
defaultAccount.description: Dipilih otomatis saat Anda membuat transaksi.

showArchived.label: Tampilkan akun yang diarsipkan
showArchived.description: Saat dinonaktifkan, akun yang diarsipkan disembunyikan dari pemilih akun.

showUpcomingTransactions.label: Show upcoming transactions
showUpcomingTransactions.description: Pin a section with overdue scheduled payments and ones due within the next 3 days at the top of the transactions list.
showUpcomingTransactions.errorNotification: Failed to update upcoming transactions setting

transactionFields.label: Optional transaction fields
transactionFields.description: Offer a quick-add button for these fields in the transaction form. A field that already has a value is always shown.
transactionFields.errorNotification: Unexpected error happened. Setting not saved

externalUrl.label: External URL
externalUrl.description: Link the transaction to an order page, booking confirmation or receipt.

externalReference.label: External reference
externalReference.description: Keep an order number, invoice number or booking reference with the transaction.

originalAmount.label: Jumlah asli
originalAmount.description: The amount actually charged in another currency, when it differs from the account's currency.

location.label: Location
location.description: GPS coordinates of where the purchase happened. Fill from your device's location or type them in

mapPicker.label: Map picker
mapPicker.description: Pick transaction locations on a map and search addresses. Map tiles and search come from OpenStreetMap, which receives your IP address when the map opens.

defaultPaymentType.label: Default payment type
defaultPaymentType.description: Preselected when you add a new transaction.
defaultPaymentType.errorNotification: Failed to update default payment type
